annotations.exact_quote: Pairwise constraint propagation has been studied extensively, where each pairwise constraint is defined over a pair of data points from a single view.
annotations.reason_zh: 明确研究成对约束传播，并扩展到视图内与视图间两类成对约束的传播，符合定义。

annotations.exact_quote: This paper presents a unified framework for intra-view and inter-view constraint propagation on multi-view data.
annotations.reason_zh: 以多视图数据为对象，显式联合利用视图内和视图间关系，符合多视图学习设定。

annotations.exact_quote: we propose to decompose these two types of constraint propagation into semi-supervised learning subproblems so that they can be uniformly solved based on the traditional label propagation techniques.
annotations.reason_zh: 将约束传播转化为半监督学习子问题，并用标签传播求解，体现有限监督与未标注样本的结合。

annotations.exact_quote: we utilize the results of intra-view constraint propagation to adjust the similarity matrix of each view and then perform inter-view constraint propagation with the adjusted similarity matrices.
annotations.reason_zh: 用传播结果修正每个视图的相似度矩阵，属于对样本间亲和/邻接关系的学习或修正。

abstentions.reason_zh: 摘要仅说明在 cross-view retrieval 上做实验，未明确不同模态查询与候选映射到可比较检索空间，多模态检索证据不足。
虽提到标签传播和相似矩阵调整，但未明确使用图拉普拉斯或流形几何一致性约束，无法确认图与流形正则化。
